finalText:
**Found it: `processOrder.js` never released its DB connection when an order failed.**

The logs line up exactly. Every `invalid order payload` error in `worker.log` bumped the pool's in-use count and never gave it back, until the pool hit 5/5 and started throwing `pool exhausted`. That cascaded into the API's `acquire timeout` and 503s, then the 2am restart.

The fix wraps the acquire in `src/jobs/processOrder.js:6` with `try/finally`, so the connection releases whether the order succeeds or fails — same pattern the API handler already used safely.

All 4 tests pass now (77ms). Nothing else touches the pool directly, so this should close the leak.
